links.comparator_used: ChatGPT answering without legislative context (training knowledge alone); human physician answers served as the reference
links.outcome: Expert-rated answer completeness and accuracy on a 5-point Likert scale, plus user preference
links.effect: No numbers in the abstract. ChatGPT with legislative context was comparable to professional doctors on completeness. Physicians still outperformed ChatGPT on accuracy. The abstract does not report the with-context versus without-context difference directly.
links.tradeoff: Users tended to prefer human-generated answers even when ChatGPT had legislative context.
links.quote: Occupational physicians perform better than ChatGPT in generating accurate questions on a 5-point likert score, while ChatGPT with access to legislative context is comparable to professional doctors in providing complete answers.
